description: Criteria tightened under 2023 Appropriation Act Item 304.ZZZZ: trial and failure of a non-GLP-1 weight loss drug in the previous 6 months, BMI 40 or higher or 35 or higher with two or more chronic conditions, service authorization for all weight loss drugs
source_citation: JCHC, Obesity and Eating Disorders Prevention and Treatment in Virginia (Commission draft, 2023), Table 4, citing DMAS memo of June 23, 2023; DMAS RD208 (March 21, 2024)
notes: Bulletin confirmed from the DMAS site 2026-11-11. It announces the criteria but states they apply once a new service authorization form is in use, so this date is the announcement, not the binding date. The form in effect 7/1/2024 still carried the pre-2023 thresholds. Implementation is the separate 2024-09-01 event. See clue C001.

description: New service authorization form puts the tightened GLP-1 criteria into force: BMI above 40 with no risk factors, or above 37 with one or more risk factors (coronary heart disease, dyslipidemia, hypertension, sleep apnea, type 2 diabetes); trial and failure of a non-GLP-1 weight-loss drug or intolerance to all of them; renewal requires 5 percent weight loss against the most recent authorization and stops once BMI falls below 25. Replaces thresholds of BMI at least 27 with two or more risk factors, or at least 30, which the form in effect 7/1/2024 still carried.
source_citation: Molina Healthcare of Virginia weight-loss service authorization forms implementing DMAS criteria: VA-ALL-PF-16714-24 (revised 6/1/2024, effective 7/1/2024, old thresholds) and VA-ALL-PF-17859-24 (revised 8/21/2024, effective 9/30/2024, new thresholds); DMAS bulletin of 6/23/2023 announcing the change
notes: Effective date is a bound, not a memo date. The DMAS form captured on the Wayback Machine showed the old thresholds on 7/28/2024 and the new ones on 9/1/2024; Molina's own form carries an effective date of 9/30/2024. Still to obtain: the DMAS memo that issued the new form, which would pin the date. The implemented thresholds (40, or 37 with one risk factor) differ from those announced in June 2023 (40, or 35 with two chronic conditions), which is a finding and not an error. Source is an MCO form carrying DMAS criteria, so under the managed-care rule it is criteria detail pending the state document.
